function: Learns jointly the UL pilot (analog CSI feedback), implicit CSI acquisition and DL precoder for SU-MIMO and MU-MIMO in TDD (p. 2).
system: TDD DL MIMO: BS 32 antennas, UE 4 antennas, K=4 users, no RIS; 7 GHz upper midband, 20 MHz bandwidth (pp. 7, 9).
method: Fully connected DNNs at UE (pilot) and BS (precoder, LMMSE-duality structure for MU-MIMO); unsupervised end-to-end training on rate loss, SGD (pp. 4, 7).
data_channel: Nokia private 7 GHz ray-tracing dataset (TR 38.901 UMa) and QuaDRiGa 7 GHz dataset; 50,000 training and 2,000 test samples from 18,000 and 2,000 UEs (p. 7).
test_conditions: Same dataset for training and testing (held-out UEs); sweeps of DL and UL SNR, pilots Np=1,2 and probing beams Nw=1 to 32; no unseen scenario (pp. 7-11).
baselines: Non-learned: LMMSE/RLS estimation with Walsh/SVD pilots plus SVD precoding, WMMSE, block diagonalization, full-CSI bounds; learned: only own naive DNN variant (pp. 8-9).
metrics: DL channel capacity (SU-MIMO) and DL sum-rate (MU-MIMO), in bps/Hz, versus DL SNR and UL SNR (pp. 8-10).
complexity: Order only: matrix inversion O(Nt^3) reduced to O((KNs)^3) by the matrix inversion lemma in the MU-MIMO module; no FLOPs, parameters or runtime (pp. 6-7).
openness: none; Nokia dataset is private and the QuaDRiGa data are generated by the authors, no code or data link (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 2: "a separate 7 GHz dataset generated by using the QuaDRiGa simulator [23]"; the Nokia ray-tracing set is TR 38.901 UMa, p. 7: "UMa in TR 38.901 [24]".
q2_support: p. 7: "we randomly selected 18,000 UEs for the training set, with the remaining 2,000 UEs forming the test set"; held-out UEs of the same data, no scenario, band or dataset unseen in training is tested.
q3_support: p. 8: "WMMSE BF with matched filter initialization and 20 iterations [28]"; baselines are all non-learned (LMMSE, RLS, SVD, WMMSE, BD). The learned 'Naive DNN (Proposed)' is the paper's own variant, p. 5: "a direct extension of the one used for SU-MIMO". No earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 7: "of the order O((KNs )3 ), where KNs is less than or equal to Nt"; the proposed MU-MIMO module needs this inversion instead of O(Nt^3). Only this order is given, no FLOPs, parameters or runtime.
q5_support: p. 7: "private mid-band dataset and a dataset created by the QuaDRiGa simulator"; the Nokia set is private, the QuaDRiGa set is generated by the authors, and no code or data link appears.
notes: PDF is the arXiv preprint (arXiv:2402.01033v1), titled End-to-End Deep Learning for TDD MIMO Systems in the 6G Upper Midbands; the DOI is not printed in it. Area 3 because the main metric is DL capacity or sum-rate of the precoder, although the pilot and CSI acquisition (area 2) are learned jointly. Borderline q3: the Naive DNN is a fully connected variant labelled Proposed, treated as an ablation, so no learned baseline. Borderline q4: only the order of the matrix inversion is reported, for the reviewer to confirm.
